*[http://www.sparklan.com/product.php?func=view&prod_id=227 Product page]
[[SparkLAN]] notes the chipset as [[MediaTek]] MT7601U. This is presumed to be in error, :MT7601U seems to be a single-stream bgn only chipset. It is presumed to use :the MT7610U (quite similarly named) - current single-stream abgn+ac chip.
*This device will likely use the default MT7610U USB ID: :0e8d:7610 (new ''MTK'' VID) / 148f:7610 (old ''Ralink'' VID)
